分诊:转决策箱 `needs-user-decision`,预挂 `domain:engine-core`。

**分类理由**:本单是 ADR-0048 的 publish-time / marketplace 半边 —— 需要 ADR addendum、保留粒度 / 共享命名空间 / 存量灰度(grandfathering)三个 open questions 均属产品契约拍板,且明示为 enterprise/marketplace 面(合约在本仓定义、执行在企业侧落地),不是可直接派发的具体缺陷。按 step 0 分类规则入维护者决策箱;深度三轴分析待实际取卡时再写。

**过时前提检查**(origin/main @ b4cdc58):install-time 门禁(#1810)仍是唯一执行点 —— `NamespaceConflictError` 在 `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:671`,带 pin 测试(`registry-namespace-install-gate.test.ts`);publish-time 注册/独占面自 2026-06-13 立单以来无任何落地。查重:三仓 open issue/PR 搜 ADR-0048 / marketplace namespace,无影子单(cloud#474 是 capability model,不同面)。前提未过时,决策仍待做。

**预挂域说明**:开源侧触点是 SchemaRegistry(install-time cross-check 选项)→ `domain:engine-core`;若维护者裁决后合约面落 docs/ADR 或拆出 cloud 侧执行单,届时按 contract-first 拆分重挂。

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。

## os-dev final report (#1825)

Drafted the ADR-0048 addendum defining the publish-time / marketplace global namespace exclusivity contract. ADR text only — no code, no gate changes, no spec changes, per the ruling. Draft PR: #6671.

**Premise re-verified against `main` @ `f123670`:** the install-time gate (`NamespaceConflictError` in `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, pinned by `registry-namespace-install-gate.test.ts`) is still the only enforcement point, and the publish-time surface has **zero** landing — `PackageSchema` in `packages/spec/src/cloud/package.zod.ts` has no `namespace` field at all, `CreatePackageRequestSchema` does not accept one, and `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` transmits `manifest_id` only. The namespace never leaves the artifact. Premise holds.

**Prime Directive #13:** nothing in §§1–6 was reversed, so nothing needed marking SUPERSEDED. The addendum is additive to §3.2 and says so explicitly at its head; the install gate's semantics and §3.5's deferral are untouched.
